wares.name: stop-motion
wares.title: Stop Motion
wares.description: A ```stop-motion fence in the md carries a numbered image series (0..n) + fps; installed and enabled, the serve-time filter decodes it into stacked frames and animates them — pure CSS steps-by-delay, no JS. Admin routes mint fences and re-time the speed (mint, speed). Malformed fences stay visible in the md: degrades, never dead.

wares.name: drunken-monk
wares.title: Drunken Monk
wares.description: Machine-generated payloads living plainly in the md: a ```drunken-monk fence carries a monk banner + a sealed base64 envelope; installed and enabled, the serve-time filter decodes it into style/script/html behaviour — ONLY envelopes sealed by the admin mint route (host HMAC integrity stamp; a hand-crafted fence degrades to the visible notice — editors cannot forge what admins mint). Editor keeps the monk, published page keeps the behaviour.

wares.name: catflash
wares.title: Catflash
wares.description: The one-pager: one page, many sections, an anchor nav that follows the scroll. Pristine graphite-on-paper starter — the blank slate you dress into a person.

wares.name: hello
wares.title: Hello
wares.description: The smallest possible proof of the plugin contract: one template placeholder (hello_badge) and one public API route (status). It ships inside Schmarrn as the preinstalled default plugin — deletable like any other, and installable here again whenever you want it back. Copy me to build your own.
